name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardExternalActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a rewarded ad requires the user to install or try another app. It tracks the external app task's progress and warns before the user leaves.
disableEffect: This external-app ad task cannot complete, and its associated rewards will no longer be granted.
